nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the estimated carbon sequestration capability of forests over 200 years old?
nodes.answer: Forests over 200 years old continue to sequester over 1.6 MgC ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, reaching up to 2.4 MgC ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ in some studies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Reforestation initiatives|Carbon sequestration initiatives_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What strategy does the EU policy include to help mitigate climate change?
nodes.answer: The EU policy includes the retention of mature trees to ensure long-term carbon sequestration.
